I’m a data analyst with a background in forecasting, replenishment, and operations. My day job involves building analytical tools, dashboards, and frameworks and has contributed to large-scale decision-making, cost savings, and operational stability.

I’m passionate about continuous learning and genuinely enjoy logical challenges. One of my greatest joys is simplifying complex topics with structure and creativity. I bring a mix of strong technical skills (Python, SQL, Tableau) and human-centered thinking, shaped by my training in data analytics and applied psychology. I’m motivated by improving processes, building reliable systems, and finding better ways for people to work smarter and stay in flow.
